title: Hold a surveyor's licence
what: Carry out cadastral surveys for fee or reward only as a licensed surveyor or under a licensed surveyor's supervision.

sources.title: Survey Act 1992 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not carry out a cadastral survey for fee or reward unless— (a) he or she is a licensed surveyor; or (b) he or she is acting under the supervision of a licensed surveyor;
